description.text: The sixth XY set, released on 6 May 2015 with 110 cards: 108 and two secret Trainers. It centers on Rayquaza and flying and Dragon Pokémon: Mega Rayquaza-EX and Mega Latios-EX made their debut among its 11 new Pokémon-EX, four of them Mega Evolutions, with Mega Turbo and Double Dragon Energy to power them.
